response: A milk delivery round began at 7 AM, heading down Main Street. The truck rolled past the gable of the first house, then the gable of the next, until it reached the community center. The driver paused to deliver milk to the gable of the senior living facility. As the round continued, the truck passed the gable of the school and the gable of the grocery store. By noon, the delivery was complete, and the neighborhood was refreshed with fresh milk.
